H4800.def: from «07337»; enlargement, either literally (an open space, usually in a good sense), or figuratively (liberty):--breadth, large place (room).

H4801.def: : from «07368»; remoteness, i.e. (concretely) a distant place; often (adverbially) from afar:--(a-, dwell in, very) far (country, off). See also «01023».

H4803.def: a primitive root; to polish; by implication, to make bald (the head), to gall (the shoulder); also, to sharpen:--bright, furbish, (have his) hair (be) fallen off, peeled, pluck off (hair).

H4804.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «04803»; to pull off:--be plucked.

H4805.def: from «04784»; bitterness, i.e. (figuratively) rebellion; concretely, bitter, or rebellious:--bitter, (most) rebel(-lion, -lious).

H4806.et: from (04754) in the sense of grossness, through the idea of domineering (compare (04756))
H4806.def: from «04754» in the sense of grossness, through the idea of domineering (compare «04756»); stall-fed; often (as noun) a beeve:--fat (fed) beast (cattle, -ling).

H4807.def: from «07378» and «01168»; quarreller of Baal, Merib-Baal, an epithet of Gideon:--Merib-baal. Compare «04810».

H4809.def: the same as «04808»; Meribah, the name of two places in the Desert:--Meribah.

H4810.def: from «04805» and «01168»; rebellion of (i.e. against) Baal; Meri-Baal, an epithet of Gideon:--Meri-baal. Compare «04807».

H4811.def: from «04784»; rebellion; Merajah, an Israelite:--Meraiah. Compare «03236».

H4812.def: plural of «04811»; rebellious; Merajoth, the name of two Israelites:--Meraioth.

H4813.def: from «04805»; rebelliously; Mirjam, the name of two Israelitesses:--Miriam.

H4817.def: from «07392»; a chariot; also a seat (in a vehicle):--chariot, covering, saddle.

H4818.def: feminine of «04817»; a chariot:--chariot. See also «01024».

H4820.et: from (07411) in the sense of deceiving
H4820.def: from «07411» in the sense of deceiving; fraud:--craft, deceit(-ful, -fully), false, feigned, guile, subtilly, treachery.

H4821.def: the same as «04820»; Mirmah, an Israelite:--Mirma.

H4822.def: plural from «07311»; heights; Meremoth, the name of two Israelites:--Meremoth.

H4823.def: from «07429»; abasement (the act or the thing):--tread (down)-ing, (to be) trodden (down) under foot.

H4824.def: patrial from an unused noun; a Meronothite, or inhabitant of some (otherwise unknown) Meronoth.:--Meronothite.

H4825.def: of foreign derivation; Meres, a Persian:--Meres.

H4826.def: of foreign derivation; Marsena, a Persian:--Marsena.

H4827.def: from «07489»; used as (abstract) noun, wickedness:--do mischief.

H4828.et: from (07462) in the sense of companionship
H4828.def: from «07462» in the sense of companionship; a friend:--companion, friend.

H4829.et: from (07462) in the sense of feeding
H4829.def: from «07462» in the sense of feeding; pasture (the place or the act); also the haunt of wild animals:--feeding place, pasture.

H4830.et: from (07462) in the sense of feeding
H4830.def: from «07462» in the sense of feeding; pasturage; concretely, a flock:--flock, pasture.

H4831.def: from «07477»; perhaps, earthquake; Maralah, a place in Palestine:--Maralah.

H4832.def: from «07495»; properly, curative, i.e. literally (concretely) a medicine, or (abstractly) a cure; figuratively (concretely) deliverance, or (abstractly) placidity:--((in-))cure(-able), healing(-lth), remedy, sound, wholesome, yielding.

H4834.def: a primitive root; properly, to press, i.e. (figuratively) to be pungent or vehement; to irritate:--embolden, be forcible, grievous, sore.

H4838.def: a primitive root; to polish; by implication, to sharpen; also to rinse:--bright, furbish, scour.

H4839.def: from «04838»; soup (as if a rinsing):--broth. See also «06564».

H4841.def: feminine of «04840»; abstractly, a seasoning (with spicery); concretely, an unguent-kettle (for preparing spiced oil):--pot of ointment, × well.

H4842.def: from «07543»; an aromatic unguent; also an unguent-pot:--prepared by the apothecaries' art, compound, ointment.

H4843.def: a primitive root; properly, to trickle (see «04752»); but used only as a denominative from «04751»; to be (causatively, make) bitter (literally or figuratively):--(be, be in, deal, have, make) bitter(-ly, - ness), be moved with choler, (be, have sorely, it) grieved(-eth), provoke, vex.

H4844.def: or mrowr {mer-ore'}; from «04843»; a bitter herb:-- bitter(-ness).

H4846.def: or mrowrah {mer-o-raw'}; from «04843»; properly, bitterness; concretely, a bitter thing; specifically bile; also venom (of a serpent):--bitter (thing), gall.

H4847.def: from «04843»; bitter; Merari, an Israelite:--Merari. See also «04848».

H4848.def: from «04847»; a Merarite (collectively), or decendants of Merari:--Merarites.

H4849.def: from «07561»; a female wicked doer:--wicked woman.

H4850.def: dual of «04751» feminine; double bitterness; Merathajim, an epithet of Babylon:--Merathaim.

H4851.def: of foreign derivation; Mash, a son of Aram, and the people descended from him:--Mash.

H4852.def: of foreign derivation; Mesha, a place in Arabia:--Mesha.

H4853.def: from «05375»; a burden; specifically, tribute, or (abstractly) porterage; figuratively, an utterance, chiefly a doom, especially singing; mental, desire:--burden, carry away, prophecy, × they set, song, tribute.

H4854.def: the same as «04853»; burden; Massa, a son of Ishmael:--Massa.

H4855.def: from «05383»; a loan; by implication, interest on a debt:--exaction, usury.

H4857.def: from «07579»; a trough for cattle to drink from:--place of drawing water.

H4858.def: from «05375»; a conflagration (from the rising of smoke):--burden.

H4859.def: feminine of «04855»; a loan:--X any(- thing), debt.

H4861.def: from «07592»; request; Mishal, a place in Palestine:--Mishal, Misheal. Compare «04913».

H4863.et: from (07604) in the original sense of swelling
H4863.def: from «07604» in the original sense of swelling; a kneading-trough (in which the dough rises):--kneading trough, store.

H4864.def: from «05375»; properly, (abstractly) a raising (as of the hands in prayer), or rising (of flame); figuratively, an utterance; concretely, a beacon (as raised); a present (as taken), mess, or tribute; figuratively, a reproach (as a burden):--burden, collection, sign of fire, (great) flame, gift, lifting up, mess, oblation, reward.

H4865.def: from «07660»; a brocade; by analogy, a (reticulated) setting of a gem:--ouch, wrought.

H4866.def: from «07665»; the orifice of the womb (from which the fetus breaks forth):--birth, breaking forth.

H4867.def: from «07665»; a breaker (of the sea):--billow, wave.

H4869.def: from «07682»; properly, a cliff (or other lofty or inaccessible place); abstractly, altitude; figuratively, a refuge:-- defence, high fort (tower), refuge, Misgab, a place in Moab:--Misgab.

H4871.def: a primitive root; to pull out (literally or figuratively):--draw(out).

H4872.def: from «04871»; drawing out (of the water), i.e. rescued; Mosheh, the Israelite lawgiver:--Moses.

H4875.def: or mshoah {mesh-o-aw'}; from the same as «07722»; (a) ruin, abstractly (the act) or concretely (the wreck):--desolation, waste.

H4876.def: or mashshu ah {mash-shoo-aw'}; for «04875»; ruin:--desolation, destruction.

H4878.def: or mshubah {mesh-oo-baw'}; from «07725»; apostasy:--backsliding, turning away.

H4879.et: from an unused root meaning to stray
H4879.def: from an unused root meaning to stray; mistake:--error.

H4882.et: from an unused root meaning to plunder
H4882.def: from an unused root meaning to plunder; spoilation:--spoil.

H4883.et: from an unused root meaning to rasp
H4883.def: from an unused root meaning to rasp; a saw:--saw.

H4884.et: from an unused root meaning apparently to divide
H4884.def: from an unused root meaning apparently to divide; a measure (for liquids):--measure.

H4885.def: from «07797»; delight, concretely (the cause or object) or abstractly (the feeling):--joy, mirth, rejoice.

H4886.def: a primitive root; to rub with oil, i.e. to anoint; by implication, to consecrate; also to paint:--anoint, paint.

H4887.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «04886»; oil:--oil.

H4888.def: or moshchah {mosh-khaw'}; from «04886»; unction (the act); by implication, a consecratory gift:--(to be) anointed(-ing), ointment.

H4889.def: from «07843»; destructive, i.e. (as noun) destruction, literally (specifically a snare) or figuratively (corruption):--corruption, (to) destroy(-ing), destruction, trap, × utterly.

H4891.et: from (07836) in the sense of day breaking
H4891.def: from «07836» in the sense of day breaking; dawn:--morning.

H4894.def: or mishtach {mish-takh'}; from «07849»; a spreading-place:--(to) spread (forth, -ing, upon).

H4897.def: from «04871»; silk (as drawn from the cocoon):--silk.

H4898.def: from an equiv. to «07804» and «0410»; delivered of God; Meshezabel, an Israelite:--Meshezabeel.

H4899.def: from «04886»; anointed; usually a consecrated person (as a king, priest, or saint); specifically, the Messiah:--anointed, Messiah.
